name: Csincse (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Csincse: a blue shield with a yellow stag and a white wavy stripe, between ears of grain and a sabre, above a green scroll inscribed CSINCSE.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Csincse arms with grain and scroll
